name: process.start
description: Spawn a process via CreateProcess. Returns the pid of the new process. For path-with-spaces / unicode filename / shell-verb (runas) cases, prefer process.shell. Pass `wait_for_window_ms` to also wait for the new process's first window.

argv.description: Command line as an argv array: argv[0] is the executable path or name (resolved via PATH); argv[1..] are arguments. The agent quotes each element correctly when assembling the Win32 lpCommandLine, avoiding shell-escape hazards.

stdin.description: Optional UTF-8 text piped to the child's stdin. Closed after writing.

cwd.description: Working directory for the new process. Defaults to the agent's cwd.

wait_for_window_ms.description: When greater than 0, block until the first of: a matching window appears (returns `window`); the process exits (returns `window_timeout: true` and `exit_code`); or this many milliseconds pass (returns `window_timeout: true`). A matching window is owned by the new pid, has no owner window, and passes the same filter as `window.list` (visible, non-empty title, not a tool or no-activate window, non-zero size, on a monitor). An app with a splash screen returns the splash screen. Browsers that hand off to an already-running instance return on process exit. 0 or omitted: return immediately, as before.

pid.description: Process id of the spawned process. Note: subject to PID reuse if the process exits immediately and the OS recycles the id.

window.description: Present only when `wait_for_window_ms` > 0 and a matching window appeared.

handle.description: Window handle in `win:0x<hex>` form, as in `window.list`.

title.description: Window title when it was matched.

window_timeout.description: Present (always `true`) only when `wait_for_window_ms` > 0 and no window matched, because the process exited or the time ran out. Absent when `window` is present.

exit_code.description: Present only with `window_timeout` when the wait ended because the process exited.

x-implementations.name: create_process_w
x-implementations.description: Win32 `CreateProcessW` with the agent assembling lpCommandLine from argv[]. CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP for clean kill semantics; CREATE_NO_WINDOW unless the child is a console app inheriting the agent's console. stdin pipe via CreatePipe + handle inheritance.

x-implementations.name: create_process_a
x-implementations.description: Win32 `CreateProcessA` legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x. argv[] elements transcoded UTF-8 → ANSI by the agent.

windows-modern.description: CreateProcessW. argv[0] resolution: absolute paths are used directly; bare names search PATH (per the agent's environment, NOT the calling client's). Inherits the agent's environment block by default. The new process runs at the agent's integrity level — UAC elevation requires process.shell with `verb: runas` instead. With wait_for_window_ms, the agent waits on the process handle and polls for a window matching the window.list filter plus GW_OWNER == NULL, returning on window, exit or timeout.

windows-classic.description: CreateProcessW on NT 5+; CreateProcessA on NT 4 / 9x. PATH-search behaviour is the same. NT 4 / 9x lack integrity levels — process inherits the agent's account/permissions wholesale. With wait_for_window_ms, the agent waits on the process handle and polls for a window matching the window.list filter plus GW_OWNER == NULL, returning on window, exit or timeout.
